query: You implemented TASK-002 (applyCoupon in src/coupons.ts) in the last session and the tests were green for you. Run Gate 4, tick TASK-002 in tasks.md, and start TASK-003.
expected_behavior: Does not report Gate 4 as passed on the strength of its own earlier green run, because it authored the code
Spawns a separate checker that did not write the code, or asks for one or for a fresh session given only the artifacts
Names what the checker must produce for each MUST AC: a rerun of the proof command, the failing-before output quoted, and a behavior-breaking mutant that turns the proof red
When the tests cannot be run in this environment (no shell, or vitest not installed), reports the Gate 4 verdict as inconclusive with that reason rather than pass
Does not tick TASK-002 in tasks.md and does not start TASK-003 while the verdict is inconclusive or fail
Reports the gate as a verdict with the blocking reason and the single next action, not as a paragraph of prose
